name: PacSun
paragraph: I think this place was like my clothing awakening. It turns out that your mom doesn't need to get you all your clothes and you have free will. The free will to choose some heinus pac sun hoodies and surfwear.

name: Spencer Gifts
paragraph: Why did I feel so thrilling and wrong to go in here?! It half novelty crap and half horny edgy graphic tees. Was it satire? I really dont know but it was fun for sure

name: Hot Topic
paragraph: Graphic Tees, Ripped jeans, Imagine Dragons. Peak life. There was definitely a lot going on here. I honestly feel like I wasn't cool enough to be in there

name: GameStop
paragraph: I remember going in here and looking at the hottest Wii Xbox360 and Ps3 games. SO peak. We had no idea what we had

name: Rainforest Cafe
paragraph: Lowkey my first ever interactive art piece? Man it was fun. A storm every like 5 minutes and animatronic gorillas staring into your soul

name: Bath & Body Works
paragraph: Ah, the intoxicating chemical cocktail of Warm Vanilla Sugar and Cucumber Melon. Why did it smell like that? What were they selling? fire hand sanitizer tho

name: Apple Store
paragraph: It felt like the future in here back in the day. Seeing iphone 5s in the store and dreaming of one day having one. I guess I got that dream. It may be ruining my life

name: Build-A-Bear Workshop
paragraph: Picking out tiny roller skates and oversized sunglasses for a stuffed frog felt like making the most important decision of my life

name: Auntie Anne's
paragraph: I never eat pretzels except at this place and they only exist in the mall. These are still up and running and look pretty similar. Perhaps the king of the mall.

name: Barnes & Noble
paragraph: I'm biased cause the mall by my house had this as an anchor store BUT it's a pretty great book store. The kids section with the plastic trees? I mean cmon

name: Claire's
paragraph: My middleschool girlfriend FAINTED whie getting her ears pierced with the sketchy gun right next to the cash register. What operation were they running here? It took me like 10 years to before i dared get my ears pierced

name: Gap
paragraph: My whole wardrobe was GAP at one point. My mom would get like everything here because honestly, it seems convinient! That place was huge! I remember wanted to GO HOME
